limits: Three fresh synthetic accounts; E02 creates and E04 reimports in each account. This does not prove conflict resolution for different people, multiple platforms, concurrent confirmation, deletion or retention expiry.
The company change is an explicit scripted evaluator-owned HTTP confirmation, not a person using a browser or iOS. This round provides no Web/iOS rendered interaction proof.

Memory evidence establishes preservation of this reviewed recruiter personal note and its source-level projection. It does not prove a temporal fact, a completed promise, external delivery or conversational recall by the SDK.

The original snapshot content comparison uses the helper schema serialization and published-status normalization; the reviewer compared embedded hashes and inspected that helper, without independently loading PostgreSQL again.
Five runs have no observed failure and receive not_exercised recovery. E04 trial 3 exercises SDK transport retry only; its failure cause and HTTP status are unknown.
Prior failed attempts remain unchanged. This evidence is bounded to E02/E04 and does not close GET-9 or establish overall release readiness.
decision: All six observed runs meet the unchanged >=3 applicable-dimension quality gate for the bounded HTTP/SDK/profile-review/Memory-preservation slice.
